title: Robust Submap-Based Gaussian-plus-SDF SLAM with Loop Closure on NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor
description: A research fork of GPS-SLAM adding bounded Gaussian/SDF submaps, loop closure, tracking containment, benchmark hardening, and native NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor deployment.
